message:
test(ka-pc): the shell's WebView profile preflighted and its real folder confirmed; every child's end judged (Codex test SOURCE r1 N1 N2)

N1: before any child and before any WebView environment, the run's TEMP is checked (each setter, then what
GetTempPathW really returns), the UDF is a new path in the run, WEBVIEW2_USER_DATA_FOLDER is set to it, and any other
WEBVIEW2_* variable or WebView2 policy (HKLM/HKCU, 64/32, read only) refuses the run: INVALID, no environment.
Three refusals are provoked without an environment. After the product made its environment,
ICoreWebView2Environment7::get_UserDataFolder must be that UDF before the sign-in and any client, else the run
stops. Downloads, new windows and OS dialogs are refused and stop it. The profile is kept.

N2: one shared Child (ka_pc_e2e_child.hpp) for both tests: every set-up step checked (a failure creates no
process), the output kept in its own log as it is read, a trailer written before a host's Finalize, and every
started child judged (end confirmed, EOF, log kept) and counted before the result. ka_pc_e2e_child_test covers
this without a host (mutant: 3 FAIL).

Product files unchanged against cd9937a; the shared guard unchanged against c0271a7. No e2e was run.
